name: dsh-reel-studio-app
description: Remotion studio for DSH plugin promo videos and promo images

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts PluginDemo out/demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:v2: remotion render src/v2/entry.tsx ReelPromo out/reel-promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --concurrency=1
scripts.render:case: remotion render src/v2/entry.tsx ReelCase out/case-better-sidebar.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --concurrency=1
scripts.render:case30: remotion render src/v2/entry.tsx ReelCase30 out/case-better-sidebar-30s.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --concurrency=1
scripts.render:proof: remotion render src/v2/entry.tsx ProofMini out/proof-mini-whale-15s.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --concurrency=1
scripts.render:story30: remotion render src/v2/entry.tsx ProofStory30 out/proof-story-30s.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --concurrency=1
